description: Entries of unsorted arrays moved, as the view's Move Up and Move Down and the script functions MoveUp, MoveDown, RemoveElement and InsertElement do (elements.move): in a new plugin's copy of the idle marker DrunkIdleMarker the second IDLA animation moves down and the fifth up (an array value of a subrecord), the first is taken out and put back in at position 3 (InsertElement); in a copied form list (FormIDs, a subrecord array of LNAM subrecords) the first entry moves down and the last up; and the first keyword of a copied weapon, an entry of the sorted KWDA array, is asked to move up, which a sorted array does not allow, so it stays.
